prompt: Authenticate a user by accepting credentials, validating them, and either showing the dashboard or denying access.
enzo:
flow LoginBasic
start Begin "Credentials entered"
task Validate "Validate credentials"
decision Valid "Credentials valid?"
task Dashboard "Show dashboard"
end Denied "Deny access"
end Done "Login complete"

Valid -> Dashboard : yes
Valid -> Denied : no
Dashboard -> Done

Denied([Deny access])

Valid -- no --> Denied
